text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
During the summer training camp, I did some digging on the 'Legend of the Secret Hot Spring'!

One day, after I began visiting the hot spring resort again.
According to what the young proprietress brought up—

text_block_list.name: Elder
text_block_list.text:
—The waters radiate a seven-colored glow!
The soothing spring seeps into wounds,
healing all manner of injury...!

text_block_list.name: Elder
text_block_list.text:
It also extends your lifespan!
My ancestor supposedly saw a beautiful jewel beetle
digging up that hot spring...!

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text:
A legendary hidden hot spring? Ah~ that one?
The one said to be dug up by green fairies!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
"Moved to tears by how overworked humans are,
the Goddess's warm tears formed a hot spring!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear,
everyone is saying completely different things, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: That's right. Others say it was a dream had by a lost hiker who ate poisonous mushrooms, or that it's actually a chemical solution synthesized by aliens.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, that's quite a problem.
Could it really be bogus after all?

I wonder how true that is.
Granted, you can't just blindly believe in a
'rainbow hot spring that cures everything,' but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Where there's smoke, there's... Well, steam doesn't
rise without a hot spring, right? Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you take your time with it, who knows,
maybe at least one real story will turn up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll ask around too!
I might spot things from a different perspective
than the proprietress who's lived here for years.
And so, I patiently continued gathering information. Then one day—

text_block_list.name: Other Inn's Head Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, the legend of the hidden hot spring! How nostalgic.
The landlady at the Yukoma Inn was looking for it back in the day, too.

text_block_list.name: Other Inn's Head Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was back when that person frequented this place
while working as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, my, stories from the landlady's past?
I wonder what kind of person
she was back when she was a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Other Inn's Head Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oh, didn't you know?
That person is the foremost authority on hot spring recuperation!

text_block_list.name: Other Inn's Head Clerk
text_block_list.text:
An era when the idea that 'hot spring therapy works for Uma Musume'
hadn't really caught on yet……

text_block_list.name: Other Inn's Head Clerk
text_block_list.text: "She's the key player who noticed the hot springs here, negotiated with the URA, and built a resort facility for Umamusume—!"

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member A
text_block_list.text: The "Racing Umamusume Rehabilitation Center" project?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a sanatorium designed to help
girls requiring long-term care recover
through balneotherapy and an improved environment.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member B
text_block_list.text:
All the way out here in a place like this...
Does hot spring rehabilitation
actually work?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Using a pool or hot spring will allow you to maintain your fitness without straining your legs during recovery.
This should help you make a speedy return—

text_block_list.name: Former Head Clerk
text_block_list.text:
A resort facility here?
If it's hot springs you want, there are other villages with 'em.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
The spring water quality here is fantastic!
It's rich in nature and easy to access.
Please, lend us your support...!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... A hot spring stepping song, you say...?
You sure are an eccentric one...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I want to leave it behind.
As a sign of respect to this land.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Lore and traditions always carry meaning. We cannot proceed with development without understanding that.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Hoshina!
Out so early in the morning again...
Are you heading to Yukoma today too?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, it's just the usual.
She'll be back in the afternoon.
After all, she has training with her trainee.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, uuu...!
What do I do... What should I do...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...You're the one, right? The girl who got fractured.
Hey, why don't you come to Yukoma Hot Springs?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You're Trainer Hoshina?!
That rumored eccentric who doubles as both a trainer and an innkeeper...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...! My recuperation theory might be
unfinished, but I'm confident it's better
than just sitting around doing nothing here.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"He's asleep anyway.
What's the harm in trying?
For both our sakes, care to give it a shot—?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, I can totally walk already...!
With this, I'll make it in time for the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's all thanks to Trainer Hoshina!
I don't even know how to thank you enough!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She got a fracture too?!
...Trainer!
Can I really get it all back, too...?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, rumors say coming here will cure anything
in an instant.
I shall believe. In the "Iridescent Hot Spring Goddess"...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fuhoooo!
Is that the Proprietress's 'street name' or something?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Iridescent, that's the one, right?
Where the green shines in all sorts of colors like a rainbow...♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I always knew the proprietress was no ordinary person,
but she really is amazing, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Other Inn's Head Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And with its therapeutic effects proven,
the hot spring town developed into what it is today!
And that's how the story goes.

text_block_list.name: Other Inn's Head Clerk
text_block_list.text: And you know, the story about when the landlady's final charge, Yunohana-san, came here... it really brings tears to your eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I just can't... anymore.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
What, don't give up!
Just give it everything you've got!
Listen, you run while making regular trips to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I was never that strong to begin with.
Getting injured so easily...
I just wasn't cut out for it.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean you're not cut out for it?
Pull yourself together. You can still run.
Once you heal, you will...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what it takes, or how long it takes,
I will get you back out there!"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: "A 'legendary hidden hot spring' that cures anything? With rainbow-colored water?!"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ridiculous.
I've been here since development began, and something like that...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Something like that...
............

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*...!
Damn it...! What am I doing...?!"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"You said you'd... 'cure it'!
And yet...!"

—In the end, no matter how much we searched, we couldn't find the 'Legendary Hidden Hot Spring.'
However...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...
So you're saying there are no shortcuts, huh.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: I'm just pursuing my own theory of recuperation to the limit.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Yunohana.
No time to hang your head!
Once you're done with the footbath, it's time to stretch.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Starting next week, we fix your form.
The injury gave you some weird habits.
We can do this. Don't worry, we'll make it in time!
And as a result of repeated training...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I won... I won!
I'm... so glad I didn't quit!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahh...!
Well done!
There was never any reason to give up...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*...!
What a wonderful story~!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly!
Ah, the tears are coming...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufu, hello.
I happened to overhear some nostalgic talk.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I was never
a strong Umamusume, but...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the proprietress and the hot springs,
I was able to live a racing career
with no regrets, you see—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what a history...
No wonder this hot spring retreat is so effective.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Testimonials from various people also show
their immense trust in the hot spring resort.
Condition: 'Heartwarming'...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
......
That's part of it, but... No, it couldn't be...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know, Tran. Tell me.
I'm pretty sure I'm thinking the exact same thing...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Tangled rumors... Rainbow-colored... Iridescent... The Hot Spring Goddess... And the "legendary hidden hot spring that cures anything"...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah...
Wait, could it be!?
Is it because the landlady did such an amazing job...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right! All sorts of anecdotes got mixed together,
spawning more and more exaggerated rumors...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: With each cycle of compression and extraction, errors occurred, corrupting the source data... you say!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hm? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: So THAT'S the truth behind the secret hot spring legend?!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
—In other words, the legend of the hidden hot spring originated
from 'the landlady's great deeds'...?

After that...
I examined the rumors closely once more, and concluded that it was almost certainly true.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: I seeeee...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, it feels so good to solve the mystery.
Not to sound insensitive, but that was pretty fun~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"So this is how 'legends' are born, huh.
Kinda bummed there's no secret hot spring, though..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If anything, it moved me deeply.
It really hit home just what a monumental feat it was.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, both the effects and the feelings behind it are real.
Isn't that right, 'Iridescent Hot Spring Goddess'♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, ridiculous.
What was all my hard work for, then?
Right, back to work.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Weeell, it definitely doesn't seem like
something you could use to revitalize the town, but..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... But I'm glad I found out.
All the feelings built up over the years
were the greatest miracle of all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Could this sort of "history"
also be part of this hot spring town's charm, I wonder...?
